text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes all 16 tests. I didn't modify any tests; all the changes are in `catalog/`:

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`. This also fixed the `age` test.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist. It now imports from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** the borrow limit was 3. I changed it to 5, which is what the comment and the tests expect.
- **`fees.py`:** the fee was calculated as `days_late + DAILY_FEE`. It's now `days_late * DAILY_FEE`.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one in the slice. I fixed that, and I also made `recent(0)` return an empty list. Without that, it would have returned the whole history. No test covers this case.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing "Emma", so I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The author, year and copy count are my own choice, since the tests only check the title.
